rows_preview.text: 十九、保养与润滑 Maintenance and Lubrication
日常保养润滑：
In cold climates where temperatures reach 1°C (30°F) or less, spray WD40 on the stainless steel moving-rod every 4~6 weeks to prevent freeze up.
For maintenance, please spray WD40 or the ordinary engine oil on the stainless steel moving-rod.
如果运行不顺畅等，可更进一步拆机臂润滑不锈钢管内壁，丝母内外侧，甚至丝杆

Besides, grease is needed to lubricate the inside of the stainless steel tube and lead screw as well as the nut (as shown below). When doing this, please take apart the actuator with reference to the steps as follows.
How to lubricate inside of the arm
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IRIA5iaWHqE
Below are the links of how to disassemble and reassemble the arm for your reference.
How to dismantle the moving-rod?
https://youtu.be/0dkm1sKYjzA
How to Install the moving rod for TOPENS swing gate opener?
https://youtu.be/5s1EQh2M_mo
1. Routine Maintenance
Spray WD40 or ordinary engine oil on the stainless steel moving rod.
In cold climates (1°C / 30°F or below):
Spray every 4–6 weeks to prevent freeze‑up.
2. Deep Lubrication (if movement is not smooth)
If the arm still does not run smoothly after routine maintenance, further lubricate:
·Inside of the stainless steel tube
·Nut (inside and outside)
·Lead screw
How to lubricate inside the arm:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IRIA5iaWHqE
✅ Use grease that can withstand the lowest local temperature in your area.
3. Guide of maintainance for your reference:
·Essential Guide to Regular Maintenance and Care for Your Gate Opener
https://topens.com/blogs/blog-posts/essential-guide-to-regular-maintenance-and-care-for-your-gate-opener
·How Do You Keep the Gate Opener Arm from Freezing in Winter
https://topens.com/blogs/blog-posts/preventing-winter-freezing-of-automatic-gate-opener-arms

formula_hits.section: 十四、电机电流小导致走停 Motor Current Too Low Causes Stalling (The Gate Stops Immediately It Starts)
formula_hits.text: 门突然启动时扯着机臂动导致电流小造成的，这种情况换控制板还不好用，只能并电阻，门的状态包括机臂电流是可能会波动的，如果只是偶尔这样，说明电流不是特别小，这个时候阻值大一点没关系，可以先试试50欧的电阻，电阻发热没那么严重，相对来说会更好一些。不行再25欧。

formula_hits.text: 负载电阻没有规定电压，只有功率要求，20欧-100欧都可以，功率要大于1152除以电阻值。
